prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D Mage survivor animation for Grave Accord. Image 1 is the APPROVED complete idle strip for this one facing. Image 2 is the original shipped single-facing seed. BOTH inputs show the exact required facing; copy their camera, profile, equipment hands and haircut. They are identity references for a whole new action sheet. Keep the same young adult man, pale face, short tousled black hair with a shaved side, broad dark indigo-blue layered robe and shoulder cape, brown leather cross strap/belt, brown boots/gloves, ONE rigid brass sun-wheel staff in his physical LEFT hand, and one CLOSED brass-brown book tethered at his physical RIGHT hip. Right hand stays free. Preserve body proportions, the slightly elevated game camera, staff design and all asymmetric equipment. No extra staff, book, firearm, shield or weapon-hand change. Use restrained dry black ink and matte opaque gouache, broad quiet cloth planes and a few selective contours. Avoid glossy gradients, excessive scratches, decorative filigree, tiny noise, magic particles, glow or flashy effects. Maintain two connected arms and two legs, a rigid staff shaft and attached hands throughout.
Every pose faces SOUTH, toward the viewer, matching the upper-left reference. Staff stays in the physical LEFT hand on viewer RIGHT; closed book stays at the RIGHT hip on viewer LEFT.
Draw exactly 6 complete full-body poses as one coherent dash animation sheet, arranged in a clear 3-column by 2-row grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Fill exactly these 6 cells with no extra figure. Action: One grounded dodge STRAIGHT TOWARD THE VIEWER, screen DOWN, while remaining SOUTH-facing and FRONT/three-quarter throughout. 1 approved upright front ready pose, 2 lower knees with chest still toward viewer, 3 one strong foreshortened step TOWARD the viewer (one boot forward, opposite knee back), 4 transfer weight on the same front-facing axis, 5 absorb landing in a low FRONT-facing stance, 6 upright front ready. Do NOT rotate chest, head or boots to an EAST/WEST side profile in ANY pose. Do NOT leap sideways across the sheet. LEFT-hand staff stays on viewer RIGHT and closed RIGHT-hip book on viewer LEFT in all six poses. The staff remains rigid and held securely, never swapped. Keep the cape restrained and connected; no speed lines, clones, wings, smoke or particles.
Use the full upright neutral pose as the common size reference; every frame shares one character scale. Keep roomy clear gutters and padding around EVERY full silhouette and the ENTIRE staff, plus a consistent ground baseline within each row. Crouched and lying bodies must retain their natural lower height, never be stretched to standing height. BACKGROUND: genuine RGBA transparency, alpha zero everywhere outside the figures, including between legs and around staff/book. No floor, ground shadow, scenery, haze, glow, vignette, colored backdrop, checker pattern, text, labels, numbers or grid lines. Preserve clean ink edges and matte gouache inside the silhouettes. Deliver the entire coherent sheet, never isolated unrelated illustrations.
